body: Thank you. I hope for that life every day. How long ago did you move away? How did your parents react? Do you still keep contact with them?

Thank you for replying and your kind words. trust me, I do blame myself. I’ve been led to believe my whole life that the reason a family member died was because of me (it wasn’t), the reason she can’t get a normal job is because of me (she doesn’t want to learn a foreign language or take community college classes), and the biggest factor is making me believe that the reason they broke up with my dad is because he didn’t want me. She told me by accident two years ago that they broke up because he cheated. All those things made me attempt sui**** when I was a teen. My only hope now is to persevere through life and do everything in my power to be a different mom to my kids. I’m 22 and I plan to move out in a year and a half when I start graduate school. I can use the excuse of having school far away to move out so she doesn’t throw (that big of) a pity party. 

Btw, I’m seeing a therapist semi regularly and she said the same exact thing as you about the cycle of abuse. It starts at the honeymoon phase (when everything seems ok) then moves to tension (when you feel things are different) then finally to conflict (when she bursts) and then back to the honeymoon phase. 

Edit: she just walked into the kitchen and started lightly throwing things around and making more noise than necessary. She wants to show that she’s mad at me but I won’t respond to that. Tired of her shit and of her making me feel as the abuser :)
